data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2021 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were $1,078.396m. Prior year development shows a gross deterioration of approximately $72.645m (strengthening), primarily driven by adverse development on older years (notably 2018 and prior) affecting Professional Indemnity, management & transactional liability, contractors liability and hull classes. COVID-19 contributed adverse prior-year impact (~$29m) and 2021 saw a number of natural catastrophe events (Hurricane Ida, Windstorm Uri, German Floods) which also influenced reserving and claims activity. The prior year strengthening was calculated from the syndicate's gross claims development triangle.

required to strengthen its 2018 and prior year of account reserves primarily in its Professional Indemnity, Management & Transactional Liability, Contractors liability and Hull classes.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was not provided explicitly as a single gross movement figure. The PYD here was calculated from the syndicate's published GROSS claims development triangle (comparing the current estimate to the prior diagonal for underwriting years 2012-2019). The report also contains net narrative figures (net deterioration $13.653m) which were not used for the gross PYD per instructions. All monetary values are reported in the syndicate's reporting currency (USD). Triangle values are presented in their native units (thousands) in the _claims_triangle section.
